result.details:
# Case 035: Shower Repair Request

## Case details
- source role: Tenant
- created: 2025-10-12 02:51:06 UTC
- property: Flat 23, 63 Meadow Row, Bellmere, ZZ6 6ZZ

## Initial request
I would like to report an issue with the shower in my property.

The water pressure from the shower has become very low compared to its normal performance. In addition, the shower hose/pipe appears to be loose where it connects to the shower head, and I am concerned that it may be damaged or starting to break.

The low water pressure is affecting normal use of the shower. I would appreciate it if someone could inspect the shower, hose, and connections to determine the cause of the problem and carry out any necessary repairs.

input.message:
Hello, an update on your shower report at Flat 23, 63 Meadow Row.

The landlord obtained the parts and arranged to fit them with you directly (our email of 12 October), and he has since telephoned us to confirm the work is complete. Before we close the request, please confirm two things:

1. Has the shower work been carried out, and are the water pressure and the hose connection now working normally?
2. The landlord's call with us referred to water damage affecting a smoke detector at the flat. Please press the test button on the smoke alarm nearest the bathroom/hallway and tell us whether it sounds. If it does not sound, or if any alarm is missing or damaged, tell us straight away and we will arrange for it to be dealt with as a priority.

If anything is still not right with the shower, let us know and we will re-open the job.
